description: Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL → 1.0 mg/dL, still normal
presentation: Patient is a 28 year old man who has urinary frequency despite treatment for a presumed UTI. Patient has nocturia and workup for polyuria was done. CMP and A1c were normal but urine sodium and urine osm were both low. Serum creatinine was 1.0 mg/dL, within normal limits. What further workup should be done to work up diabetes insipidus or other etiologies?
